summary: The Lenox Public Library and Public School system rely heavily on E-Rate funding to provide internet access and services. Without E-Rate funding, they will face barriers to attending school, finding jobs, accessing healthcare, and more. The library and schools depend on E-Rate to provide essential services and connectivity to their community.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, libraries and schools will have to cut core services, programs, and operations to maintain internet service
claims.evidence_quote: Without E-Rate funding, we will have to cut core services, programs, and operations to maintain the internet service our community requires.
